title: Webb County Sheriff's Office joins Finley Elementary Career Day
excerpt: The Webb County Sheriff's Office took part in Finley Elementary School's Career Day, where Corporal Morales and Deputy Ramirez talked with students about the work of law enforcement and careers in public service.
content:
The Webb County Sheriff's Office took part in Finley Elementary School's Career Day, giving students a chance to learn more about the role of law enforcement and the career opportunities available in public service.

Corporal Morales and Deputy Ramirez spoke with students about the responsibilities of a law enforcement officer and the importance of serving others.

Sheriff Martin Cuellar thanked Finley Elementary for the invitation and for the chance to inspire the next generation of leaders.

Source: Webb County Sheriff's Office, Facebook, Nov. 18, 2026.
